SELECT
    count() AS customer_count,
    corr(c.YearlyIncome, s.total_online_spend) AS income_spend_correlation,
    avg(c.YearlyIncome) AS avg_yearly_income,
    avg(s.total_online_spend) AS avg_total_online_spend
FROM retail.DimCustomer AS c
INNER JOIN
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        sum(SalesAmount - ReturnAmount - DiscountAmount) AS total_online_spend
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
) AS s
    ON c.CustomerKey = s.CustomerKey
WHERE c.YearlyIncome IS NOT NULL
